app.name: Character Builder
app.about: A tool that helps you build a character for a role-playing game step by step and print it as a sheet.

login.privacyNote: We only store your email address and your characters. Nothing else.

pick.noOptions: There is nothing to choose here right now.
pool.blocked: No pick is free for this any more.

option.explainEmpty: Tap an option. More about it will show up here.
dist.method: How do you want to set the values?
dist.notEnough: You do not have enough points for that. Lower another value first.
dist.tapNext: Where does the {value} go? Tap a value below.

print.title: What do you want to download?
print.sheetText: Your character with all the numbers. To play with and to write on.
print.cardsText: A card for everything you look up often while playing. To cut out, nine to a page.
print.cardsNone: Your character has nothing that comes as a card.
print.texts: Rules texts to read up on
print.textsText: The full texts of everything your character can do. To read instead of cutting out.
print.noPart: Pick at least one of them.
print.stateText: What you write in on screen is then already on the sheet: numbers, ticks, notes.
done.notFinished: This character is not finished yet.
done.editHint: You can view and change the character at any time.
growth.title: What grows with your {levelName}
origins.title: What you get without choosing

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Applies right away to all texts. Your character stays the same.
settings.unitsHint: Applies right away, everywhere: on screen, on the sheet and on the cards. “Same as the language” changes when you change the language. Any other choice stays.
settings.saveError: That did not work. Please try again.
settings.passwordText: We will send you a new password. The old one then stops working.
settings.passwordConfirmText: The old password then stops working. You will be logged out on other devices.
settings.passwordSent: A new password is on its way.
settings.languageModelText: You can install a program on your computer. With it, a language model reads your characters and builds with you. You choose the language model yourself. Our server sends nothing to anyone else.
settings.languageModelWithKey: Put a key in the package
settings.languageModelWithKeyText: The package then holds a password to your account. Do not share it.
settings.languageModelWithoutKeyText: Then you add a key yourself. The guide in the package shows where.
settings.languageModelDone: The package is downloaded. Unpack it and open the file README.md. It tells you what to do next.
settings.languageModelKeyText: It is already in the package. Copy it only if you need it somewhere else. We show it only this once.
settings.languageModelKeyListed: You now find it below under “{section}”. You can withdraw it there at any time. Then the package can no longer get into your account.
settings.languageModelTooMany: You already have {max} keys. Withdraw an old one below under “{section}”. Or download the package without a key.
settings.languageModelUnavailable: This server does not offer the package right now. Tell the person who runs the server.
settings.keysText: With an access key, a program you trust can work in your account: build, change and print characters. It can do everything you can do here, but only in your account.
settings.keyNameHelp: So you know it again later, for example “Claude Desktop at home”.
settings.keyNameMissing: Write briefly what the key is for.
settings.keyNewText: Copy it now and give it to your program. We show it only this once.
settings.keyRevokeText: A program with the key “{name}” ({hint}…) can then no longer get into your account. Your characters stay.
settings.keysTooMany: You already have {max} keys. Withdraw one first.
settings.logoutText: You can log in again with your email address at any time.
settings.privacyText: Your email address, your password and your access keys as a check value, your settings and your characters. Nothing else.
settings.deleteText: Deletes your email address, your settings, your access keys and all your characters.
settings.deleteDialogText: We will delete your email address, your settings, your access keys and all your characters ({count}). This cannot be undone.
goodbye.title: Your account has been deleted.
goodbye.text: We deleted everything: your email address, your settings and your characters.
privacy.title: What we store
privacy.intro: We only store what the builder needs to work.
privacy.email: Your email address. We use it to send you your password.
privacy.password: Your password, only as a check value. Nobody can work out the password from it.
privacy.keys: Your access keys, if you make any: only as a check value, with the name you give it and the date. We do not record when a key is used.
privacy.campaigns: Your campaigns: their name and who leads them.
privacy.cookies: One cookie so you stay logged in. And one that remembers your language before you log in.
privacy.noTracking: No tracking, no ads, no statistics about you.
privacy.noThirdParty: Your browser loads nothing from other sites. No outside fonts, no outside scripts.
privacy.languageModel: You can download a package with which a language model of your choice, on your computer, reads your characters. Our server sends nothing to anyone else. Your characters go only to the language model you set up yourself.
privacy.delete: You can delete your account in the settings at any time. Then everything is gone.
raise.question: Which {levelName} is {name} going up to?
raise.questionUnnamed: Which {levelName} is your character going up to?
raise.oneUpNote: This is the usual step after an adventure.
raise.keep: Everything you have chosen stays. You only answer what is new at {levelName} {level}.
raise.keepRange: Everything you have chosen stays. You only answer what is new on the way to {levelName} {level}.
raise.error: That did not work. Your character has not changed. Please try again.
raise.atTop: {levelName} {level} is already the top. It does not go higher.
raise.notFinished: Finish the character first. Then you can level it up.
raise.cancelText: {name} stays at {levelName} {level}. What you chose since then is kept, in case you level up later.
raise.cancelError: That did not work. Please try again.
raise.earlier: You chose this before levelling up. You can change it here.
done.raisedNothing: {levelName} {level} brings no new questions. The numbers are already updated.
done.reprint: Print the sheet again. The old one is out of date.
raise.cancelTextUnnamed: Your character stays at {levelName} {level}. What you chose since then is kept, in case you level up later.
campaigns.title: My campaigns
campaigns.intro: In a campaign a group plays together, often over many evenings. Whoever leads it sees every player's characters and can help build them.
campaigns.newHelp: For example the name of your group. You will lead the campaign.
campaigns.nameMissing: Give the campaign a name first.
campaigns.tooMany: You already lead {max} campaigns. That is the most you can have.
campaigns.emptyTitle: You are not in a campaign yet.
campaigns.emptyText: Do you lead a group? Then create a campaign above. Do you play? Then the person who leads your game adds you, and you get an email.
campaigns.loadError: We cannot load your campaigns right now.
campaigns.leaveText: Your characters stay with you. The person who leads the game will no longer see them.
campaign.notFound: This campaign does not exist, or you are not part of it.
campaign.youLead: You lead this campaign. You see your players' characters. You can keep building them and print them.
campaign.addHelp: The person gets an email from us. It says that you ({email}) are inviting them to “{name}”. If they have no account yet, the email also holds their password.
campaign.added: {email} plays now. We have sent an email.
campaign.cannotAddYourself: That is your own address. You already lead the campaign.
campaign.tooManyPlayers: More than {max} players is not possible.
campaign.tooFast.one: You have just sent many invitations. Please wait 1 minute.
campaign.tooFast.other: You have just sent many invitations. Please wait {count} minutes.
campaign.noPlayers: Nobody plays yet. Enter a player's email address above.
campaign.removeText: The characters stay with this person. You will no longer see them.
campaign.deleteText: The campaign and its list of players go away. Everyone keeps their characters.
campaign.playerText: The person who leads the game sees your characters. They can keep building them and print them. Only you can delete them.
new.forPlayer: You are building this character for {email}. It then belongs to that person and is in their list. You can still keep building it.
done.forPlayer: The character belongs to {email}. They find it in their list.
settings.deletePlayer: If you play in a campaign, your characters go away there too, and the campaign stays for the others.
settings.deleteGameMaster: If you lead a campaign, it goes away with its list of players, and the players keep their characters.
privacy.membership: Who plays in which campaign. Whoever leads a campaign therefore sees the players' characters and can change them. Only the owner can delete a character.
privacy.invitations: If someone adds you to a campaign, you get an email. It says who added you.
sheet.notFinishedText: The sheet is there as soon as your character is finished. You can already open your own versions above.
sheet.languageMissing: This sheet does not exist in your language.
sheet.otherDevice: Another device was first. This now shows what was saved there.
sheet.copyGone: This version no longer exists. This is the original.
sheet.limit: You have {max} versions of your own. The original can no longer be changed; your versions can.
done.copies.one: You have one version of the sheet of your own.
done.copies.other: You have {count} versions of the sheet of your own.
